geography.specific_cruising_subsection: not established whether alleged outdoor gardens/steps or building interior
geography.coordinate_note: Historic monument's address not an exact cruising point

original_primary.read_evidence: Indexed city directory names historic building as 'natural area', with no directions/remarks that place the claimed cruising in or beside the monument.
original_primary.retrieval_limit: Original source detail/map unlocated; full public detail not read due to unavailable city HTML/site-specific index.

source_content.finding: Casa de la Vall interior was closed from 2025-04-01 and partially reopened 2025-12-23 after 8 months of restoration. Not proof outdoor area open or cruising space restored.

529 visitors after reopening, opening Tue-Sat 10:00-14:00 and 15:00-18:00, closed Sunday/Monday/holidays and subject to official events. These apply to heritage visits, not necessarily garden/public access.
Later phase planned redevelopment of landscaped areas BEHIND monument with green walls and furniture, which may alter an older outdoor spot; no confirmation which part Gays-Cruising meant.
Garden complex had closed for works from Feb 2025 and major modifications planned through Sep 2026 incl amphitheatre replacing old parking. Historical claim may refer to now-changed exterior.
Address Carrer de la Vall, guided-visit museum hours; no cruising claim. Time-sensitive availability subject to parliamentary notices.

activity_evidence.interpretation: Heritage monument operating hours and garden renovation cannot be treated as evidence for or against cruising; exact area not established.

records.access_status: Interior partially reopened 2025-12-23, heritage visitor schedule restricted; surrounding gardens undergoing redevelopment in 2026. Do not falsely label entire site permanently closed or operational cruising.
